_source: Manually curated from https://untappd.com/blog's 'New Badge: X' posts - these are Untappd's own time-limited promotional badges, never in the permanent badges.untappd.com catalog (badge_beer_categories.json/badge_venue_categories.json), so they have to be read and re-catalogued by hand whenever a new one is announced. Checked live 2026-11-26 - entries are ACTIVE-or-UPCOMING as of that date (activeUntil >= today). This list remains empty: no entries expired since the 2026-11-23 check (none existed to prune). One new post was found since then, 'New Badge: Merry Punchmas' (Nov 27 - Dec 27, 2026, USA check-ins only) - its criteria is 'check in any beverage' with no style/country-of-origin restriction, and the USA-only part is a check-in-location restriction this schema can't compute (badge_stats.py's kind:country matches beer.country, not the user's location), so it was logged in special_badges_pending_review.json instead of guessed here. 'Untappd Check-In Challenge: Week 4' (already in special_badges_pending_review.json, Nov 23-29) is still active, not yet expired. All other posts seen on this check (Week 3, Bar Fly, Week 2, the Season-1 intro, International Stout Day, Amaro Day, Champagne Day, 16th Anniversary, Mezcal Day, Gin & Tonic Day, Scream-Worthy Hard Cider, Liqueur Day, the all-new-Untappd announcement) are already-handled posts from earlier checks. Re-check the blog periodically (no feed/API for this - it's a real page read each time) and prune entries whose activeUntil has passed, same way this list was built.
